Title: Generally Available: High Scale Private Endpoints

Body.Content:
You can now increase Azure Private Endpoint’s virtual network (VNet) limits by upgrading to High Scale Private Endpoints (HSPE). Today local VNet limits are restricted to 1,000 private endpoints per Virtual Network. Any attempts to create additional endpoints will result in an PrivateEndpointsPerVnetLimitReached error that can only be resolved by either deleting existing private endpoints or raising a support request to increase present limits. However, by activating HSPE you will automatically be able to deploy 5,000 PEs in a singular VNet.  

It is also recommended that you only deploy up to 4,000 Private Endpoints in total across your peered virtual networks. Surpassing this recommendation may result in connectivity issues with your private endpoint traffic. If you would like higher limits without the risk of connectivity issues, it is recommended to upgrade to HSPE. This will raise private endpoint cross peering limit to 20,000 endpoints.

Additionally, Azure Virtual Network Manager’s High Scale Private Endpoints support for mesh (connected groups) is now generally available, offering greater scalability for complex Azure network topologies. HSPE for mesh enables you to scale private connectivity across large, interconnected environments with ease.

Regions of Availability:

This feature is available in all public regions.

  • About High Scale Private Endpoints.
